title: Pakistan Studies
summary: Freedom movement dates, constitutional history, geography and national symbols.
definitions: Muslims and Hindus are separate nations — articulated by Sir Syed, Iqbal and Jinnah.
facts: 1906 Muslim League (Dhaka) · 1905 Partition of Bengal (annulled 1911) · 1916 Lucknow Pact · 1919 Khilafat Movement.
1928 Nehru Report → 1929 Jinnah's 14 points · 1930 Allahabad Address (Iqbal).
23 March 1940 Lahore Resolution (moved by A.K. Fazlul Haq, Minto Park).
1942 Cripps Mission · 1946 Cabinet Mission · 3 June 1947 Plan (Mountbatten).
First Governor-General: Quaid-e-Azam. First PM: Liaquat Ali Khan. Joined UN 30 Sept 1947.
1966 Tashkent (USSR mediation) · 1972 Simla · 28 May 1998 nuclear tests (Chagai) — Youm-e-Takbeer.
Gwadar bought from Oman in 1958. Durand Line 1893.
Anthem: Hafeez Jalandhari (lyrics), Ahmed G. Chagla (music), adopted 1954.
National: language Urdu, animal Markhor, bird Chukar, flower Jasmine, tree Deodar.
Largest province by area Balochistan; by population Punjab. Khyber Pass → Afghanistan; Khunjerab Pass → China.
traps: Lahore Resolution was presided over by Jinnah but MOVED by Fazlul Haq.
Muslim League was founded in Dhaka, not Lahore or Aligarh.
